subject: general
question: Amit and Deeksha together invested ₹17,400 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹6,000, Amit's share was ₹2,800. What was the investment of Amit?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit ratio = Investment ratio

Amit : Deeksha = 2800 : (6000 − 2800) = 2800 : 3200 = 7 : 8

Total ratio = 15 parts

Amit investment = (7/15) × 17400

= 8120

**∴ Answer = ₹8120**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total investment = 17400

Total profit = 6000

Amit’s profit = 2800

Deeksha’s profit = 6000 − 2800 = 3200

**Formula used:**

Profit ∝ Investment (when time is same)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio of investments = Ratio of profits

⇒ Amit : Deeksha = 2800 : 3200

⇒ Divide by 400 ⇒ 7 : 8

⇒ Total parts = 7 + 8 = 15

⇒ Amit’s investment = (7/15) × 17400

⇒ = 7 × 1160

⇒ = 8120

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Basic Rule

Profit is divided in the ratio of investments when time period is same.

Investment-Time Concept

If time differs, profit ratio = Capital × Time.

Ratio Simplification

Always simplify ratios to smallest integer form for easy calculation.

Division Using Ratio

Share = (individual ratio ÷ total ratio) × total amount.
